visualCharacteristics.structure: data table inside a white dashboard widget; column count varies (2-4)
visualCharacteristics.headers: light blue #8ab9ea header cells, small 10px dark text left aligned, tall (~50px) header row
visualCharacteristics.rows: first column label on light grey #eee (14px), numeric cells centered on grey #ddd (12px); 2px white gaps; LAST ROW = Totals row, bold text on darker grey #a2a2a2 (separated visually by empty space above in source; not required)
visualCharacteristics.purpose: Fleet metrics by car type ending in a bold Totals row

contentPattern.pattern: fleet metrics by car type with a bold totals row as the final row
contentPattern.structure: first row is the header (Car Type, then 1-3 metric column names); each following row is a car type label followed by its numbers; the LAST row is always the Totals row (label Totals plus the column totals) and renders bold. Works with 2, 3 or 4 columns
